added.title: New features
items: Introduced revised cloud and liquid effects, GPU bloom and additional reflection controls.

items: Preserved saved 3D characters during profile changes and initial sign-in.

added.title: New features
items: Added a finite character departure animation, improved profile selection and removed the character dust effect.

fixed.title: Homepage and profile chooser
items: Placed profile details and shortcuts directly above the profile chooser with a small gap.
Simplified the memory value to GB only.
Refined dropdown spacing and selection states, replacing the small profile arrow with a menu icon.

added.title: Profile identity and character effects
items: Choose from 50 profile icons and a custom icon color in profile settings.
Show your chosen icon in profile pictures, beside the Home profile name and in the profile content header.
Added subtle gold dust behind the 3D character that responds to character rotation.
The character and gold dust grow slightly on hover, with reduced-motion support.

bugs.title: Verification limits
items: Live layout, character effects and input still require user verification.

fixed.title: Selection and homepage layout
items: Moved profile information and shortcuts further down on Home.
Added gold outlines and full-row mouse and keyboard selection for profiles and accounts.
Replaced the three window-control symbols with matching centered icons.

fixed.title: Standard client and visual cleanup
items: Unified the normal mod catalog as Mods, removing EZ tags and the Premium switch.
Removed experimental Minecraft renderer selection and Minecraft shader-pack downloads from the standard client.
Matched the rounded profile chooser and Play button, strengthened the title and removed content dividers.
Added individual gold mod icons.

fixed.title: Homepage layout
items: Moved the Bloxdy Client title to the top of the home panel.
Aligned profile details and gave Edit profile and Browse mods matching buttons.

fixed.title: Launcher controls
items: Made dropdowns more compact and aligned menus with the complete field.
Removed the Play without mods button.

added.title: Homepage and performance
items: Gold Bloxdy heading with selected profile details and direct edit/mod actions.
On-demand launcher RAM and CPU readings, profile memory budget, system RAM and diagnostic shortcuts.

added.title: Launcher redesign
items: Website-inspired black, cream and gold palette with Manrope typography and glass primary buttons.
Updated navigation, profiles, accounts, settings and mod browser.

fixed.title: Launcher
items: Removed the description beneath the launcher title.

added.title: Installation guide
items: Windows installation steps with screenshots at the bottom of this page.

fixed.title: Mod settings navigation
items: Switching categories clears the previous selection.
Mod settings reopen without an empty page.
Smooth wheel timing is disabled when smoothing is off.

fixed.title: Party Voice removed
items: Party Voice and its microphone access have been removed.

added.title: Zoom text
items: Show percentage and multiplier separately, together, or hide both.
Adjust text size, X/Y position, and color. Uses the game font without a background.
Removed the visible-width display; added direct Windows downloads.

added.title: Linux preview

fixed.title: Zoom release and mouse wheel
items: Releasing V restores normal zoom; small wheel movements are recognized.
